scope: Position/size/rotation/flip and explicit nested transforms; research/provenance receipt, not whole API parity.
notice: Original TypeScript wording and XML assets. Existing test-case-map-notice.txt and upstream-license-notice.txt retain research notices.
selection: All base-shape position/dimension/rotation variants; all corresponding shared-shape BDD examples; adjacent group extent and placeholder inheritance obligations retained individually. No flip-specific baseline case was found. Unit helpers retain length-case-map.json coverage; custom builder geometry remains in path-case-map.json.

mappings.original-domain-behavior-covered: Original XML trees assert integer values and absent geometry across all five drawing kinds. Explicit rot=0 is equivalent to omitted default. Dimensions 321/654 and position 123/456 retain fixture semantics. Sequential dimensions require an existing second extent; initial pair creation is explicit.
mappings.domain-workflow-covered-model-gap: Original XML and sequential typed mutations retain every expanded example value. Document-owned Picture/GroupShape/Connector/GraphicFrame live subclasses remain pending. Domain tests do not count as complete public model parity.
mappings.deferred-adjacent-api: Group collection extent recalculation and inherited placeholder resolution remain pending. Local transform assignment retains child mapping rather than automatic collection resizing. No parity claim.
